decisionsCard.body: When a moderator makes a decision about something you posted, you always hear about it here, with the reasons and how to challenge it. You can’t switch these off.

statementDecisions.hide: a moderator hid something you posted.
statementDecisions.remove: a moderator removed something you posted.
statementDecisions.restrict: a moderator limited who can see something you posted.
statementDecisions.warn: a moderator sent you a warning.
statementDecisions.suspend: a moderator paused your account for a while.
statementDecisions.public_note: a moderator added a note to your story.
statementDecisions.reporting_pause: a moderator paused your reports for a while.
statementDecisions.rating_raised: a moderator raised your story’s rating.
statementDecisions.ai_label_added: a moderator labelled your story as AI-written.

reportOutcomes.removed: we checked your report {{reference}} and removed what you reported.
reportOutcomes.acted: we checked your report {{reference}} and took action.
reportOutcomes.no_action: we checked your report {{reference}}. It doesn’t break our rules or the law, so we left it up.

appealOutcomes.open: your appeal {{reference}} is waiting for a moderator.
appealOutcomes.upheld: a different moderator looked at your appeal {{reference}} again. The decision stands.
appealOutcomes.overturned: a different moderator looked at your appeal {{reference}} again and changed the decision.
